'''Dreadbane''' is a title in the [[Borderlands]]. It is given to a person who has slain a [[Myrddraal]]. It does not matter whether the Myrddraal is slain in single combat or if it had previously been wounded.{{ref/book|14|p}}

The title refers, presumably, to those that defeat a Myrddraal without the aid of the [[One Power]], which would not be difficult for any channeler of at least middling strength.

==Known Dreadbanes==
Omitting those who kill a Myrddraal using the One Power:
*[[Talmanes Delovinde]] {{ref/book|14|p}}
*[[Thom Merrilin]] (possibly){{ref|{{twotc}}, Thomdril Merrilin}}
*[[Mat Cauthon]] {{ref/book|5|22}}{{ref/book|4|37}}
*[[Lan Mandragoran]]{{ref/book|14|9}}{{ref/book|14|16}}
*[[Ihvon]]{{ref/book|4|40}}
*[[Rand al'Thor]] killed one in hand-to-hand combat{{ref/book|4|10}}
*[[Slayer|Lord Luc]] arrives with a Fade's head claiming to have killed it.{{ref/book|4|45}}
*[[Perrin Aybara]] {{ref/book|3|5}}
[[Padan Fain]] also kills Myrddraal and other more powerful Shadowspawn, but this is not surprising considering his powers.
